## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are loading state requirements defined for asynchronous book list queries? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are accessibility requirements specified for all interactive UI elements (swipe, tap, keyboard)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are error handling requirements defined for local database failures (disk full, corruption)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the JSON export format structure explicitly documented in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for concurrent user interactions during book editing? [Coverage, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "case-insensitive substring matching" precisely defined with examples for search behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Are validation error message requirements specific and consistent across all fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027/FR-028]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the term "platform-native drag/swipe equivalent" quantified for desktop platforms? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are field length limits consistently specified across all text fields including ISBN? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026/FR-018]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the soft-deleted book restoration process clearly documented in requirements? [Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do soft deletion requirements align between book list swipe (FR-006) and detail view delete (FR-030)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006/FR-030]
- [ ] CHK012 Are bookmark page range validation rules consistent across add and edit operations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK013 Do localization requirements apply consistently to all UI elements including validation messages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019/FR-027]
- [ ] CHK014 Are cascade delete rules consistent between constitution (hard delete) and spec clarifications (soft delete)? [Conflict, Constitution Principle V vs Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can success criteria SC-001 through SC-005 be objectively measured with specific test conditions? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK016 Are acceptance scenarios testable and unambiguous for each user story? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Stories 1-3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the 200ms swipe-to-delete target measurable with defined visual feedback criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Are acceptance scenarios defined for the JSON export functionality (FR-031)? [Gap, Spec §FR-031]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for zero-state scenarios beyond empty book list? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Are alternate flow requirements specified for bookmark editing with overlapping pages? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3/FR-029]
- [ ] CHK021 Are exception flow requirements defined when device language is neither German nor English? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery requirements documented after soft-deleted book restoration (bookmark visibility)? [Recovery, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is the fallback behavior specified when ISBN validation encounters edge cases (hyphen variations, whitespace)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK024 Are overlapping bookmark display rules clearly specified with ordering criteria? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the behavior defined when a soft-deleted book's ISBN is reused in a new book? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements specified for bookmark notes containing special characters or emojis? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are performance requirements quantified for all critical user journeys including export? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001 to SC-005/FR-031]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the SQLite database migration strategy documented in requirements? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are data persistence requirements specified for app restart and device reboot scenarios? [Completeness, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK030 Are storage capacity warning requirements defined when approaching practical limits (~10,000 books)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption of "always available local storage" validated with failure mode requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Are MAUI target platform differences addressed in requirements (Android vs iOS vs Windows vs MacOS)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption of "device system language defaults to German or English" validated with fallback behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK034 Do bookmark cascade delete requirements conflict between constitution (hard delete on parent removal) and spec clarification (soft delete preserves bookmarks)? [Conflict, Constitution Principle V vs Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the term "platform-native drag/swipe equivalent" consistently defined across all desktop platforms? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-022]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the requirements for "note indicator icon interaction" specific about display mechanism (popup, inline, navigation)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
